exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you ate at a restaurant.
Some people prefer to eat at home, while others prefer to eat at restaurants. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about opening a small restaurant in your neighborhood. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

The city is considering banning fast-food restaurants within 500 meters of schools to improve children's health. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
